llm.summary: This is an instruction-only proposal/consulting framework that requests no credentials, installs, or external code and its requirements align with its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: The skill is a proposal-generation and sales-framework assistant. It requires no binaries, no environment variables, and no install steps — which is consistent for an instruction-only guidance skill that provides templates, scoring frameworks, and process steps.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains structured frameworks (BANT-Plus, discovery extraction, pricing tiers, proposal structure, follow-up cadence) and actionable instructions for creating proposals. It does not instruct the agent to read unrelated system files, access environment variables, or send data to unexpected endpoints. The guidance is scoped to proposal-related tasks.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files; the README suggests using 'clawhub install' but the published package is instruction-only. No downloads, archives, or third-party packages are pulled by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. That is proportional for a template/framework skill. There are links to external paid 'context packs' in the README, but those are optional resources and not required env/credentials for this skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not marked always:true and does not request persistent system-wide configuration or other skills' credentials. Autonomous invocation is allowed by default (platform normal), but nothing in the skill grants elevated or persistent privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is instruction-only and does not request credentials or install code, so it's relatively low-risk. Before use: (1) Review the templates with sample data (don't paste real client PII until you're confident). (2) Be cautious about the external 'context pack' links in the README — they lead to third-party pages and paid content, so verify the vendor before purchasing. (3) Test generated proposals and payment/terms language with your legal or finance owners before sending to clients. (4) If you see any prompt text that requests secrets or asks the agent to call external APIs, stop and review — the published SKILL.md does not require that behavior. Overall the skill appears coherent with its stated purpose.
